review_outcome: Implemented optional file-backed reviewed-registry store and strict enriched acceptance; quality review found no blockers; provenance/hash and wording findings were fixed; full quality gates and live reviewed-registry enriched acceptance passed

decisions.decision: Use an opt-in file-backed reviewed Narrative Registry store at data/registry/narrative_registry.reviewed.json.
decisions.rationale: The future web approval workflow needs a durable registry target that can be read by the pipeline today and written by approval actions later, without treating approved registry data as a mock provider.

decisions.decision: Keep the default registry mode as fixture until reviewed registry acceptance is proven.
decisions.rationale: Default V1 outputs and existing tests remain stable while the enriched real-provider path progressively removes mock layers.

decisions.decision: Encode reviewed-registry source URLs with a path scope and content hash.
decisions.rationale: Future web approval snapshots can share a basename, so provider provenance must distinguish registry paths and content versions in reports and manifests.
